title: Ocular Motility
description: A calm, guided conversation about ocular motility, the test where a patient follows a small light while the optometrist watches both eyes travel together. The episode covers the six directions, why the head stays still, and what drift or lag might suggest in the gentlest terms. Listeners also hear how the test feels from the chair and how a basic result is described. Join Focus Cast by focuslinks for another step through the basic clinical measurements.
